title: A snapshot can hold a time column as a whole timestamp
symptom: DimTime rows from the snapshot missing in silver; rows changed later through the change log were right
cause: Oracle keeps a time as TIMESTAMP(0), so the snapshot export writes 1970-01-01 04:05:33; silver read only HH:MM:SS text
effect: The snapshot rows of a time column come out NULL or wrong
fix: Silver takes the time of day from a whole timestamp too
